appStore.subtitle: Rep counter that counts aloud
appStore.promotionalText: Set your sets, reps and rest, press Start and train hands-free. Every rep is spoken out loud and fills the screen, so you never lose count.
description: Big Workout Counter counts your reps out loud, so your eyes can stay off the screen and your mind on the movement.

Choose your sets, reps per set, seconds per rep and rest between sets, then press Start. After a short get-ready countdown, each rep number is spoken and shown huge on screen. Between sets a rest countdown runs, and the next set is announced when it is time to go again.
FEATURES
• Spoken rep count at the pace you choose, from half a second to ten minutes per rep
• Up to 99 sets and 999 reps per set
• Rest timer between sets, with the next set announced
• Get-ready countdown with a spoken 3, 2, 1
• Big, high-contrast numbers you can read from across the room
• Pause, resume or finish early at any time
• Summary of total time, sets and reps completed
• Keeps the screen awake while you train
• Speaks over your music, even with the silent switch on
• Remembers your last settings
• Works offline: no account, no ads, no tracking
Great for tempo training, bodyweight circuits, physio and rehab exercises, planks and holds, and any routine where you would rather listen than count.
appStore.reviewNotes: Big Workout Counter needs no account or network connection. Enter sets, reps, seconds per rep and rest, then tap Start: after the get-ready countdown the app speaks each rep number using the device's text-to-speech voice and shows it full screen, runs a rest countdown between sets, and shows a summary at the end. Turn the volume up to hear the counts; they also play with the silent switch on.
